# Matt Krall

> Matt Krall is an executive coach and Co-Founder of Elevate You. He works with senior executives and operators who know their strategy is sound but want to understand why execution still breaks down under pressure.

Matt's work centers on closing the gap between the leader someone intends to be and the leader who actually shows up when pressure arrives. His framework — Awareness, Alignment, Activation — explains why personal and organizational change typically fails (people are asked to activate before they're ready) and what sequence actually produces durable behavior change.

## Primary Offer
The Clarity Conversation is the entry point for all of Matt's work: a structured diagnostic conversation (not a sales call) designed to surface the real gap between a leader's intention and their behavior under pressure. There is no obligation to continue afterward.

## Secondary Offer
The Inner Game of Leadership is Matt's selective 1:1 private coaching practice, built around the same Awareness → Alignment → Activation sequence, for leaders whose external success has outpaced their internal integration.

## Organizational Work
When the gap is no longer just the leader but the organization around them, Matt refers people to Elevate You (https://goelevateyou.com), the company he co-founded, which installs behavior change at scale across teams and organizations.

## Background
In 1999, Matt was given a mandate by Capital One to launch a new internet servicing center in Seattle in 90 days. A pivotal moment with a teammate named Jim — who told him his team could carry the load if he let them — shaped Matt's view that leadership under pressure is fundamentally a transfer of energy, not just strategy. He has since held executive roles at Capital One, GE, and Credit One Bank, and has 30+ years of experience at the intersection of performance, people, and pressure.
